你也可以把它们放置在家具上[/size]

[b][size=4]如何使用：[/size][/b][size=3]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]安装[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]CP[/url]﻿和[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]MMAP[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]将文件解压放入mods文件夹[/size]
[*][size=3]打开游戏，前往玛尼的牧场购买鸟屋，与鸟屋互动即可获取到所有家具[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=4]推荐与 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]任意位置放置家具[/url] 和 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]精确家具[/url] 一起使用[/size]

[b][size=4]How to use:[/size][/b][list=1]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]CP[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]MMAP[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the files and place them in the Mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]Launch the game, go to Marnie's Ranch to purchase a birdhouse, and interact with it to obtain all the furniture.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=4]Recommended to use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]Build and Place Anything Anywhere[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url]﻿.
